metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Passaic County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Bloomingdale Borough Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 4.718%, with an equalization ratio of 59.25%.
Public education represents 58.9% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 26.2%.
Average residential assessment is $257,738, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,160.08.

equityAnalysis.summary: Bloomingdale Borough maintains a consistent residential tax base across its residential zones.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Bloomingdale Borough, homeowners pay an average of $12,160.08 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 12.33% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 59.25%, assessed values average ~59.25% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 58.9% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 26.2%, and Passaic County claims 14.9%.
